# Domain layer

Packages: "domain layer" in `doc/ai/architecture.md`. Rules: "domain" in
`doc/ai/code-conventions.md`. Examples: `.github/references/domain.md`.

- Imports only `java.*` and other `domain` classes. No Spring, MyBatis, Jakarta or Jackson.
- Entities, value objects, aggregates and IDs in `domain`; exceptions in `domain.exception`;
  repository interfaces in `domain.repository`; services in `domain.services`; policies in
  `domain.policies`; guards in `domain.guards`.
- Aggregates: private constructor, static factories (business name and `restore(...)`), no
  setters; business methods protect the invariants.
- Typed positive IDs generated by `repository.nextId()`; `long version` for optimistic locking;
  other aggregates referenced by ID only.
- Time comes from an injected `Clock`. No domain events.
- `ArchitectureTest` enforces the dependency rule and these packages.
